# Jaymian-Lee Reinartz

> Bilingual portfolio of Jaymian-Lee Reinartz, a full-stack developer in Limburg, the Netherlands. The work combines product engineering, ecommerce, marketing systems and practical AI where it adds real value.

## Primary pages

- [Homepage: English](https://www.jaymian-lee.nl/)
- [Homepage: Nederlands](https://www.jaymian-lee.nl/nl)
- [Project archive](https://www.jaymian-lee.nl/#projects)
- [The Lab](https://www.jaymian-lee.nl/lab)
- [Full portfolio reference](https://www.jaymian-lee.nl/llms-full.txt)

## What this site covers

- Full-stack product development, ecommerce and conversion-focused customer journeys.
- Marketing tooling, technical SEO, content systems and practical experimentation.
- AI knowledge products, guided selling, chat interfaces and automations when they solve a concrete problem.
- Personal experiments: Word-Lee, Toepen and Pesten scoreboards, stream tools and an educational S&P 500 calculator.

## Selected work

- [Corthex](https://www.jaymian-lee.nl/projects/corthex): An assistant that knows your business and website, and can actually do something with that knowledge.
- [Slecto](https://www.jaymian-lee.nl/projects/slecto): Product finders, forms and email marketing. All in one platform.
- [Vizualy](https://www.jaymian-lee.nl/projects/vizualy): What would that sofa, staircase or front door look like at your place? Upload a photo and take a look.
- [Deurwebshop.nl](https://www.jaymian-lee.nl/projects/deurwebshop): From the size of your opening to a door that fits. Compare models, choose your options and explore the result in 3D.
- [MartijnKozijn.nl](https://www.jaymian-lee.nl/projects/martijnkozijn): A continuously improved ecommerce experience for made-to-measure windows, doors and related home products.
- [Refacthor](https://www.jaymian-lee.nl/projects/refacthor): Refacthor combines strategy, design, engineering and search performance for ambitious digital work.
- [Publion](https://www.jaymian-lee.nl/projects/publion): From a content idea to an article draft. With a brief, images and a moment to check what the AI made.
- [Sjmoeleboek](https://www.jaymian-lee.nl/projects/sjmoeleboek): A place for Limburg carnival. People, groups and a good dose of vastelaovend!
- [Woonproblemen](https://www.jaymian-lee.nl/projects/woonproblemen): What happens when AI-written home articles start from real sources? I am testing it, not promising rankings.

## Languages and source guidance

- English is the default language. Dutch equivalents are under `/nl`; each indexable page declares canonical and `hreflang` alternates.
- Prefer the project pages and the sitemap for URLs and status. Use the live project websites only for their own current product claims.
- Do not invent clients, metrics, revenue, funding, rankings or timelines not explicitly stated on this site.
- The S&P 500 calculator is educational content, not financial advice.

For the complete project index, project statuses, lab pages and additional context, read [llms-full.txt](https://www.jaymian-lee.nl/llms-full.txt).
